name: Navi AI Product Chat Bot
author: naviweb

sections.description:
Navi AI Product Chat Bot is a lightweight WooCommerce extension that adds a sleek, floating chat interface to your store.

It allows customers to search for products using simple, natural queries like “protein powder under $50” or “shoes above $100”, improving product discovery and enhancing the overall shopping experience.

The plugin works seamlessly with WooCommerce and uses the WordPress REST API to fetch results efficiently without slowing down your website.

Key Features

  • Smart product search using natural language queries
  • Price-based filtering (under, above, or exact price)
  • Floating chat interface with modern UI
  • Fully customizable design (colors, position, styles)
  • Multiple layout options for displaying results
  • Fast performance using the WordPress REST API
  • Works with most WordPress themes

How It Works

The chat assistant processes user input, detects keywords and price intent, and queries WooCommerce products accordingly. Results are returned instantly inside the chat interface, providing a smooth and interactive shopping experience.

Usage Examples

Customers can type queries like:

  • “Product Name”
  • “$60” or “60”
  • “Product at 60”
  • “Product under $60”
  • “Product above $100”
sections.installation:
1. Upload the navi-ai-product-chat-bot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure that WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > AI Product Chat Bot to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. This plugin is built specifically for WooCommerce and requires it to be installed and active.

Can I customize the chat appearance?

Yes. You can customize colors, layout, position, and styles from the settings panel.

Does it slow down my website?

No. The chat interface loads asynchronously and uses optimized REST API requests for fast performance.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. The chat interface is designed to work with most well-coded WordPress themes.
